## API
- [data/v1/index.json](data/v1/index.json) — manifest: every endpoint with description, schema URL, updated timestamp, record counts
- [data/v1/trends.json](data/v1/trends.json) — all topics, full dossiers
- [data/v1/trends.flat.json](data/v1/trends.flat.json) — flat opportunity-ranked feed (stale excluded)
- [data/v1/velocity.json](data/v1/velocity.json) — hourly velocity snapshots per topic (Oracle input)
- [data/v1/forecasts.json](data/v1/forecasts.json) — precomputed 48h trajectory forecasts (Oracle output: confidence basis, signal attribution, per-platform trajectories)
- [data/v1/platform-velocity.json](data/v1/platform-velocity.json) — per-platform hourly velocity series (per-platform trajectories input)
- [data/v1/forecast-accuracy.json](data/v1/forecast-accuracy.json) — the Oracle's own forecast-vs-actual scorecard (building history; hit rate appears after 10+ forecasts resolve)
- [data/v1/lifecycle.json](data/v1/lifecycle.json) — the Oracle's ignition/burnout lifecycle layer: per-topic stage (building/steady/warming/igniting/peaking/cooling/burned-out), stage ribbons, last-24h ignitions/burnouts boards (readouts, not predictions)
- [data/v1/meme-formats.json](data/v1/meme-formats.json) — the tracked meme format families: curated families with current examples, evidence, verification flags, and live topic links
- [data/v1/hashtags.json](data/v1/hashtags.json) — tag index
- [data/v1/schema/](data/v1/schema/) — draft-07 schemas for every endpoint
- [AGENT.md](AGENT.md) — how an agent uses this tracker (end-to-end workflows)

## Oracle (flagship)
- [oracle.html](oracle.html) — 48h peak forecasts: projections from hourly velocity snapshots, honestly labeled; forecasts unlock after 3 snapshots per topic
- [forecast-accuracy.html](forecast-accuracy.html) — the Oracle's own scorecard: per-horizon accuracy, by-call breakdown, recent resolutions, current 48h projections; hit rate appears only after 10+ forecasts resolve (honest 'building history' before that)
- [formats.html](formats.html) — the tracked meme format families: current examples, evidence, verification flags; formats are reusable templates to join
- [launch-plan.html](launch-plan.html) — 7-day content battle plans from each topic's own angles/hooks/hashtags (printable, copy-as-text)

## Algorithm mechanics (Oct 2026)
- [algorithms.html](algorithms.html) — what TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram Reels reward right now: signal hierarchies, the Oct 1 Shorts originality update, cross-platform breakout consensus; sourced and dated

Freshness: every topic carries first_seen/last_seen; stale (>72h) topics are flagged.
